points.title: 童年与教育启蒙
points.description: 福柯1926年出生于法国普瓦捷的一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲是一位著名的外科医生，家庭环境相对保守。在普瓦捷的童年和青少年时期，福柯接受了传统教育，展现出卓越的学术才能。他早期对哲学产生浓厚兴趣，尤其受到现象学的影响。这段时期为他后来的学术发展奠定了基础，培养了他对权力、知识和主体性关系的早期思考。
points.descriptionEn: Foucault was born in 1926 in Poitiers, France, into a middle-class family. His father was a prominent surgeon, and the family environment was relatively conservative. During his childhood and adolescence in Poitiers, Foucault received traditional education and demonstrated exceptional academic talent. He developed a strong interest in philosophy early on, particularly influenced by phenomenology. This period laid the foundation for his later academic development and cultivated his early thinking on the relationships between power, knowledge, and subjectivity.

points.title: 巴黎高师求学
points.description: 福柯进入巴黎高等师范学院(ENS)学习哲学，这是法国最顶尖的学术机构之一。在此期间，他受到现象学、马克思主义和尼采思想的深刻影响。1950年，福柯加入法国共产党，但于1953年因对斯大林主义的不满而退出。在ENS期间，他完成了关于康德的论文，并开始对精神病学和心理学产生兴趣，这为他后来的研究埋下伏笔。这段时期塑造了他独特的思想方法，融合了哲学批判与历史分析。
points.descriptionEn: Foucault entered the École Normale Supérieure (ENS) in Paris to study philosophy, one of France's most prestigious academic institutions. During this time, he was deeply influenced by phenomenology, Marxism, and Nietzschean thought. In 1950, Foucault joined the French Communist Party but left in 1953 due to his disillusionment with Stalinism. At ENS, he completed his thesis on Kant and began developing an interest in psychiatry and psychology, which would later inform his research. This period shaped his unique approach, combining philosophical critique with historical analysis.

points.title: 早期学术生涯
points.description: 福柯在巴黎开始了他的学术生涯，先后在多个机构任教和研究。他出版了《精神疾病与心理学》(1954)和《临床医学的诞生》(1960)等早期著作。这一时期，福柯开始发展他的'知识考古学'方法，研究知识的历史建构。他还担任《法国哲学杂志》主编，积极参与学术圈活动。1950年代末，福柯短暂前往瑞典和波兰任教，这些经历拓宽了他的国际视野，也使他接触到不同的学术传统，进一步丰富了他的思想体系。
points.descriptionEn: Foucault began his academic career in Paris, teaching and researching at various institutions. He published early works such as 'Mental Illness and Psychology' (1954) and 'The Birth of the Clinic' (1960). During this period, Foucault developed his method of 'archaeology of knowledge,' studying the historical construction of knowledge systems. He also served as editor of the 'Revue de Métaphysique et de Morale' and actively participated in academic circles. In the late 1950s, Foucault briefly taught in Sweden and Poland, experiences that broadened his international perspective and exposed him to different academic traditions, further enriching his thought system.

points.title: 学术突破与重要著作
points.description: 福柯在克莱蒙-费朗大学任教期间完成了他最具影响力的著作之一《词与物》(1966)，该书探讨了知识的历史结构和话语系统。1968年，他出版《知识考古学》，系统阐述了他的方法论。在克莱蒙-费朗时期，福柯与哲学家丹尼尔·德费(Daniel Defert)建立了长期关系，这段关系对他的个人生活和思想发展产生了深远影响。1968年的法国学生运动对福柯产生了重要影响，促使他更加关注权力、社会控制和反抗等议题，这反映在他后来的工作中。
points.descriptionEn: While teaching at the University of Clermont-Ferrand, Foucault completed one of his most influential works, 'The Order of Things' (1966), which explored the historical structures of knowledge and discursive systems. In 1968, he published 'The Archaeology of Knowledge,' systematically articulating his methodology. During his time in Clermont-Ferrand, Foucault established a long-term relationship with philosopher Daniel Defert, which profoundly influenced his personal life and intellectual development. The 1968 French student movement had a significant impact on Foucault, prompting him to focus more on issues of power, social control, and resistance, which would be reflected in his later work.

points.title: 思想转向与法兰西学院
points.titleEn: Intellectual Shift and Collège de France
points.description: 1968年后，福柯的思想发生重要转变，从知识考古学转向权力谱系学研究。1970年，他被任命为法兰西学院'思想体系史'教授，这是法国学术界的最高荣誉之一。在巴黎期间，福柯积极参与社会运动，关注监狱改革、同性恋权利等议题。他开始研究权力与知识的关系，以及权力如何通过微观实践运作。这一时期，福柯的思想更加政治化，他开始将理论分析与现实社会问题紧密结合，发展出独特的权力批判理论。
points.descriptionEn: After 1968, Foucault's thinking underwent a significant shift, moving from archaeology of knowledge to genealogical studies of power. In 1970, he was appointed Professor of the History of Systems of Thought at the Collège de France, one of the highest honors in French academia. During his time in Paris, Foucault actively participated in social movements, focusing on issues like prison reform and gay rights. He began studying the relationship between power and knowledge, and how power operates through micro-practices. During this period, Foucault's thought became more politically engaged, as he began to closely connect theoretical analysis with real social problems, developing his unique theory of power critique.

points.title: 成熟期著作与全球影响
points.description: 在法兰西学院任职期间，福柯完成了他最重要的著作，包括《规训与惩罚》(1975)和《性史》(1976-1984)。他发展了'生命权力'和'自我技术'等核心概念，深刻影响了后现代理论、文化研究和社会学。福柯频繁前往美国、巴西、日本等地讲学，他的思想在全球范围内产生广泛影响。1980年代，福柯的健康状况恶化，但仍坚持学术工作。1984年6月25日，福柯因艾滋病并发症在巴黎去世，享年57岁。他的去世标志着20世纪最重要思想家之一的离去，但他的思想遗产继续影响着当代学术和社会理论。
points.descriptionEn: During his tenure at the Collège de France, Foucault completed his most important works, including 'Discipline and Punish' (1975) and 'The History of Sexuality' (1976-1984). He developed core concepts such as 'biopower' and 'technologies of the self,' profoundly influencing postmodern theory, cultural studies, and sociology. Foucault frequently lectured in the United States, Brazil, Japan, and other countries, with his thought gaining widespread global influence. In the 1980s, despite deteriorating health, Foucault continued his academic work. On June 25, 1984, Foucault died in Paris from complications related to AIDS at the age of 57. His death marked the passing of one of the most important thinkers of the 20th century, but his intellectual legacy continues to influence contemporary academia and social theory.

supporter.zh: 福柯被誉为20世纪最重要的思想家之一，他的权力谱系学和知识考古学方法彻底改变了人文社会科学的研究范式。支持者认为福柯揭示了现代社会中权力运作的微观机制，挑战了传统自由主义对权力的理解。他的思想为边缘群体和反抗运动提供了理论武器，影响了后现代主义、酷儿理论和后殖民研究等领域。福柯强调知识与权力的共生关系，揭示了看似中立的知识体系如何服务于权力结构，这一洞见至今仍具有强大的解释力和批判性。
supporter.en: Foucault is celebrated as one of the most important thinkers of the 20th century, whose genealogical and archaeological methods revolutionized research in the humanities and social sciences. Supporters argue that Foucault revealed the micro-mechanisms of power operation in modern society, challenging traditional liberal understandings of power. His ideas provided theoretical weapons for marginalized groups and resistance movements, influencing postmodernism, queer theory, and postcolonial studies. Foucault's emphasis on the symbiotic relationship between knowledge and power, revealing how seemingly neutral knowledge systems serve power structures, remains profoundly influential and critical today.

critic.zh: 批评者指出福柯的理论存在诸多局限：他过于强调权力而忽视了抵抗的可能性；他的历史分析有时过于碎片化，缺乏连贯的历史叙事；他对启蒙理性的全盘否定被指责为相对主义和虚无主义；他的理论被认为过于抽象，难以指导具体的社会变革实践。此外，福柯晚年对伊斯兰革命的态度也引发争议，被批评者视为对其早期激进立场的背离。一些学者还质疑福柯的个人生活与其理论的一致性，特别是他对权力关系的批判与他自身在学术机构中的地位之间的矛盾。
critic.en: Critics point out several limitations in Foucault's theory: his overemphasis on power while neglecting possibilities of resistance; his historical analysis sometimes being overly fragmented without coherent historical narratives; his wholesale rejection of Enlightenment reason being criticized as relativism and nihilism; and his theories being considered too abstract to guide concrete social change practices. Additionally, Foucault's late attitude toward the Iranian revolution sparked controversy, seen by critics as a departure from his earlier radical positions. Some scholars also question the consistency between Foucault's personal life and his theories, particularly the contradiction between his critique of power relations and his own position within academic institutions.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，福柯被定义为一位跨学科的思想革新者，他的影响力远超哲学领域。他的概念如'规训社会'、'全景敞视主义'和'生命权力'已成为描述现代社会的重要术语。福柯的思想在学术界引发了持续辩论，既被广泛引用，也受到严格审视。在流行文化中，他的形象常与反叛、边缘化和对权威的挑战联系在一起。福柯的著作被翻译成多种语言，影响全球学术界，他的思想成为理解现代性、权力和主体性不可或缺的参考框架。尽管存在争议，福柯仍被视为20世纪思想史上的关键人物，其遗产持续塑造着当代知识生产的方式。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Foucault is defined as an interdisciplinary intellectual innovator whose influence extends far beyond philosophy. His concepts such as 'disciplinary society,' 'panopticism,' and 'biopower' have become essential terms for describing modern society. Foucault's ideas have sparked ongoing debates in academia, being both widely cited and critically examined. In popular culture, his image is often associated with rebellion, marginalization, and challenging authority. Foucault's works have been translated into numerous languages, influencing global academia, and his thought has become an indispensable reference framework for understanding modernity, power, and subjectivity. Despite controversies, Foucault remains a pivotal figure in 20th-century intellectual history, whose legacy continues to shape contemporary knowledge production.

self.zh: 权力不是一种制度，也不是一种结构；它不是我们拥有的某种东西；它是从不同点被行使的 strategical 关系。
self.en: Power is not an institution, and not a structure; neither is it a certain strength we are endowed with; it is the name that one attributes to a complex strategical situation in a particular society.

others.zh: 福柯是一位真正的思想探险家，他重新定义了我们思考权力、知识和主体性的方式，他的著作是20世纪思想地图上不可忽视的坐标。
others.en: Foucault was a true intellectual explorer who redefined how we think about power, knowledge, and subjectivity; his works are indispensable coordinates on the intellectual map of the 20th century.
